name: What is involved in a professional refrigerator water line installation?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a professional refrigerator water line installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional refrigerator water line installation typically involves connecting your refrigerator's water dispenser and ice maker to your home's main water supply. This often includes installing a new shut-off valve, running a copper or PEX line from the valve to the refrigerator, and ensuring all connections are secure and leak-free. Our technicians at CG Plumbing Solutions will assess the best route for the line, often through cabinets or behind appliances, to ensure a clean and efficient setup. They will also test the system thoroughly to confirm proper water flow and pressure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional refrigerator water line installation connects your fridge to the home's water supply, including valve installation, running the line, and ensuring leak-free connections.
